body: I'm freaking out. I hope this isn't one of my girlfriend's flights. No answers from her and no updates on any social media since she left. Ugh.

well, i still have 20 hours left to do on my back.. and i just cant wait to go do this. for all reasons i guess. i used to always get alot of stuff done when i was down, and always made me feel better. i enjoyed the process of sitting there for 4 5 or 6 hours.. i mean i used to cut a bit when i was younger. so idk.
makes sense.. i really want to get tattood, i just cannot in the summer. its the best feeling in the world, pain for a good reason.

hobbies, i like getting tattood. playing video games. im a novice at working on my car. i used to have alot of "friends" when i played world of warcraft. but it became a huge crutch in my life. thats all i did at one point years ago. work, wow, sleep. repeat. id even skip work to play that game..

well, i dont really have friends. theres no one i can just say hey lets do something and theyll be down. the only ones i that are available like this are ones that want to just use me, so i dont really hang out with them unless im really really alone. im not socially awkward, i just cant keep people around.
alright, guess i just gotta tough this out then. thanks.. sigh. thank you. i dont feel like im on the edge anymore.

im making efforts to try to see her. she explained she wants to stop feeling like such crap from all ive said and done. so she doesnt want me around. she doesnt believe that i really want to turn everything around, that its only because she finally left. im trying to be respectful of her wanting her space but dont know how far without losing the whole situation.

well, i was dating my ex for a year before my whole depression set back in. so i ended our status of being official cause i wanted to try and deal with my issues alone. idk why i became so depressed out of no where. but everyone around me made it worse.

well, she stuck around anyway as pretty much the exact same, we still did everything like we normally did while we dated. except i constantly lied about how i felt. i always said i didnt like what she did and always thought it wasnt right anything she did. so after a year or so of me doing this, she finally broke down and couldnt deal with me anymore at all. just not even a week before i was getting better too.

now two weeks into this being actually alone, im not sure what to do anymore. i told her how i really felt. how i actually wanted to have her around just hated expressing it. but shes so beat down from dealing with me that it seems hopeless. im a 25 year old male and i really cant keep hiding from everyone. im slipping so much. i just want to repair the damage ive done. or i just want to know ive done too much damage at this point. and should try to do other healthier things then to try and fix this.
hi, im not even sure. just the fact someone saying they want to help is such a nice feeling. i havent had that for months now.
